wins.text: Innovative Medicine delivered first-ever $15B+ quarterly sales at $15.2B, growing 3.8% operationally despite a ~1,170 bps STELARA headwind; ex-STELARA growth was 15.5%
Oncology operational sales grew 22.3% in Q2, led by DARZALEX (+21.5%), CARVYKTI (+100%+, $439M), ERLEADA (+21%), and RYBREVANT+LAZCLUZE (+100%+, $179M)
Full-year operational sales guidance raised by ~$900M to a midpoint of $92.9B (4.8% growth), and adjusted EPS guidance raised $0.25 to $10.85 midpoint

MedTech delivered 6.1% operational growth in Q2, a 4.4 percentage point sequential improvement vs. Q1, with Cardiovascular growing 22%+ driven by Abiomed (+16.9%), Shockwave (strong double-digit), and EP (+9.8%)
SPRAVATO grew 53% and TREMFYA grew 30.1% in Q2; TREMFYA expected to reach $10B+ peak annual sales driven by IBD expansion

risks.text: STELARA declined 43.2% in Q2, creating an ~1,170 bps headwind to Innovative Medicine and ~710 bps headwind to total company growth; biosimilar erosion expected to accelerate through year-end, modeled similar to HUMIRA year 2

Adjusted diluted EPS declined 1.8% YoY to $2.77, driven by interest expense from Intra-Cellular acquisition debt and STELARA gross profit erosion; Innovative Medicine margin fell from 44.6% to 42.7% and MedTech margin fell from 25.7% to 22.2%

Tariff impact on MedTech business estimated at ~$200M for 2025 (down from prior $400M estimate); future-year tariff impact on pharma remains uncertain, with potential pharma-specific tariffs announced by the administration
Orthopedics declined 1.6% due to competitive pressures, transformation program execution, and China VBP headwinds; Surgery also facing competitive pressures in energy and China VBP

Net debt position of $32B ($51B debt vs. $19B cash) following $14.5B Intra-Cellular acquisition; effective tax rate guided higher to 17%-17.5% for 2025, with GILTI rate increase adding ~1% to global effective tax rate in 2026

guidance_items.detail: Full-year operational sales growth raised to 4.5%-5.0% (midpoint $92.9B, +4.8%); reported sales growth 5.1%-5.6% (midpoint $93.4B) including ~$1.1B favorable FX vs. prior guidance
Adjusted diluted EPS raised $0.25 to $10.80-$10.90 range (midpoint $10.85, +8.7%), including $0.08 of operational improvement and favorable FX
Full-year operating margin improvement of ~300 bps reiterated despite year-to-date softness; expected to materialize in H2 via efficiency programs and absence of nonrecurring H2 2024 IP R&D charges
Net interest expense now projected at $0-$100M, improved from prior guidance, driven by higher interest earned on cash balances
Tariff impact for 2025 revised down to ~$200M (from ~$400M prior), exclusively in MedTech; differential to be reinvested in pipeline and launches

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Pharma-specific tariff risk and J&J's U.S. manufacturing capacity/flexibility to absorb potential 2026 tariff impact
OTTAVA robotic surgery submission timeline clarification (analysts perceived a pushout to 2026 that management disputed)
TAR-200 launch readiness details — sales force training, supply chain, patient access programs, and penetration assumptions
